calls.video_title: I Just Invested $20,000 into the Stock Market (Here is what I bought)
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated (was BUY 24 Nov). Bought Friday last week and again Wednesday this week; reestablishing the Nasdaq-100 position through QQQM (0.15% expense ratio) as a foundational long-term holding. The Nasdaq-100 briefly fell ~20% into a bear market; he believes valuations are intriguing even after adjusting 2027 earnings for slowdown fears, and expects a relief rally possibly followed by one more leg lower - he is accumulating rather than timing the bottom.
calls.base_case: High-quality Nasdaq-100 names compound over 3-5 years from much lower valuations.
calls.bull_case: The sell-off proves to be near the bottom and the relief rally extends into a sustained recovery.
calls.bear_case: One more leg lower comes and earnings estimates fall significantly, changing the valuation equation.
